title.en: Compare the Table Before and After Cleaning

brief.zh: 切换区域名规范化、缺测处理和按编号去重，观察每一步怎么改变原表。
brief.en: Toggle area normalization, missing-value handling, and deduplication by ID to see what each step changes.

concept.zh: 温度转成数字后，每项清洗规则都能单独比较。
concept.en: Once readings are converted to numbers, try each cleaning rule on its own.

hints.zh: 先只规范区域名，找找原表第 4 号记录。再打开去重，找第 9 号记录。
hints.en: Normalize area names first and find record 4. Then turn on deduplication and find record 9.

prompt.zh: 试着一次打开一个清洗选项，再对照记录编号看到哪里改变了。
prompt.en: Turn on one cleaning option at a time, and compare IDs to see what changed.
